title: remoteInference allowed with no opted-in scopes still means local execution
rationale: The trap is reading allowed: true as the authorisation. It is not — the scope list is. An empty list opts nothing in, so an engine that crosses the trust boundary here has sent the user’s reading to a provider on the strength of a flag that authorised no scope at all. The runner additionally enforces, on every result in the suite, that a remote execution names an optInScope the manifest actually opted in.

requirement.text: Domain Scope ids for which remote inference is permitted. Empty or absent with allowed=true means no scopes are opted in.

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
